title: Punch Miller humiliated by the Earl Hines band at the Grand Terrace
summary: Alfred tells how Hines's men walked off the stand when Punch could not read the music, and how Guy Kelly insisted on seeing the music.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
